final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT P.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX <> '' GROUP BY P.SEX), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.sex AS sex, s1.cnt AS cnt, (s1.cnt * 1.0) / s2.total AS prop FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL AND s2.total <> 0), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM s3) SELECT s3.sex, s3.cnt, s3.prop, s3.cnt - s4.av FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.cnt > s4.av
